recap: Created jsonc-remove-key Node.js CLI in scripts/bin/json/ with symlink, using jsonc-parser to remove top-level keys from JSONC files while preserving comments
Created 5 npm-* autoload helpers (is-published, is-deprecated, is-logged-in, login, deprecate) with behavioral tests for is-deprecated
Created 4 git-github-* autoload helpers (repo-is-archived, repo-description, repo-description-set, repo-archive) as thin gh wrappers with input guards
Created project-remove autoload helper that delegates to jsonc-remove-key with input guard and idempotent behavior
Created deprecate-prepare ZSH script that gathers project info (projects.jsonc, GitHub, disk location, npm status) and returns JSON
Created deprecate-end ZSH script that orchestrates all deprecation steps (GitHub archive, npm deprecate, projects.jsonc remove) idempotently with fail-fast error JSON
